{{Youmay|the reconnaissance fighter used by the Galactic Alliance|the [[TIE/rc starfighter]], used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]}}
The '''TIE Reconnaissance Fighter''' was a [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth]] variant of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. The prototype served with [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of which nicknamed the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] "the '''Blur'''," during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].

==Characteristics==
The TIE Reconnaissance Fighter was a cutting-edge craft developed a generation after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the closest rival that [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] had produced to the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[StealthX]].<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

In spite of this, its basic design remained similar to the much earlier [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|bomber]], [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle|shuttle]] and [[TIE/br boarding shuttle|boarding craft]] variants of the TIE, with two cylindrical hulls placed side-by-side between its wings. As with the previous designs, the starboard fuselage contained the cockpit.<ref name="Fury" />

The major innovations lay in the left-hand hull. In previous twin-fuselage TIE designs, this been a munitions bay or passenger nacelle, but on the TIE Reconnaissance Fighter, it housed a number of advanced systems intended to improve the fighter's combat and infiltration performance. There was a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] generator, and a full [[Life support/Legends|life support]] system, which had not been standard on most earlier TIEs, plus sophisticated [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth]] countermeasures.<ref name="Fury" />

The fighter may not have been quite as advanced as the StealthX, however. At least one prototype had just a plain black finish on the hull, rather than the hologram-like camouflage which made the Jedi infiltrator appear as no more than a ripple in the starfield.<ref name="Fury" />

Nevertheless, the fighter retained the traditional speed and maneuverability of the TIE lineage.<ref name="Fury" />

==History==
A prototype TIE Reconnaissance Fighter was assigned to the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|Star Destroyer ''Anakin Solo'']], the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]]. During the feigned negotiations before the [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|ambush by Centerpoint]], it was assigned to an officer named [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Olavey]], to test it under field conditions.<ref name="Fury" />

Caedus, believing his daughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] to be under threat from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], took over the fighter and used it to ferry the youngling away from the Star Destroyer&mdash;only to find himself ambushed by [[Red Sword Flight]], an assassination squad of Jedi flying StealthX fighters.<ref name="Fury" />

The capabilities of the new fighter and its [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] pilot were not enough to prevent the Jedi scoring several hits. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] quickly had the TIE in his sights for a deadly shot, but he refused to fire when he detected Allana's presence aboard the TIE, and this brief hesitation allowed more Alliance fighters to come up in support of the TIE Reconnaissance.<ref name="Fury" />
